name: medqa_s68_v1_r2_strict_early
responses: 34-year-old female. The patient reports experiencing pain in her right thumb and wrist, which radiates to her elbow for the past three months. The pain worsens when she holds her infant son and is alleviated somewhat with an ice pack. She mentions a history of falling on her right outstretched hand about six months ago. She also notes that her mother has a history of chronic joint pain treated with methotrexate. The patient has been taking ibuprofen as needed for her symptoms.
patient has been taking ibuprofen as needed for her symptoms. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Gastroenteritis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.
